title: Hotelogix + Zoho Books: Hotel Accounts on Autopilot #Shorts
description:
Hotelogix and Zoho Books just partnered: guest invoices, payments and booking data from the hotel PMS flow straight into Zoho Books, with invoice generation and GST compliance automated and bookings in your financial dashboards. Here is what it means for a small hotel.

1. First, connect Zoho Books to Hotelogix from the Hotelogix integrations marketplace.
2. Every checkout then sends the guest invoice and the payment to Zoho Books, with no retyping.
3. Invoices are generated with GST applied, so your filing data stays up to date.
4. Bookings and payments also land in your Zoho Books dashboards, so you see cash flow every day.

API / tool used:
- name: Hotelogix - Zoho Books integration
- endpoint: Hotelogix marketplace: Zoho Books
- docs: https://www.hotelogix.com/marketplace/product/zoho-books

story.title: Hotelogix and Zoho Books Partner to Deliver a Connected Operations and Finance Platform for Hotels
story.summary: Hotelogix (cloud hotel PMS, 100+ countries) and Zoho Books partner to deliver a connected operations and finance platform for hotels (Hospitality Net, 11 Nov 2026). Hotelogix marketplace (official): with Hotelogix, Zoho Books pulls guest invoices, payments and booking data to automate expense tracking, tax filing and monthly reports; imports Hotelogix bookings and payments into financial dashboards; automates invoice generation and GST compliance workflows. Menu path inside Hotelogix / Zoho Books: not published.
